title: Land, Overrun, swing: sequence a lethal turn without tapping the attackers
briefing: P1 plays a whole turn. With the land drop, Overrun is castable from five Forests alone, which keeps Llanowar Elves untapped to attack as a 4/4 trampler. Overrun then makes 15 trampling power against P3 at 13 life behind one 2/1 blocker: lethal only if all three creatures attack P3. The traps: casting Overrun before the land (the Elves get tapped for mana and 11 power is not enough), casting Harmonize instead (same mana, no kill), attacking before casting Overrun, and attacking the wrong player. The blocked attacker's trample damage is a decision too: the seat must assign 1 to the blocker and the rest to the player, or the kill is lost at the last step.

reference.analysis: Five Forests after the land drop pay for Overrun ({2}{G}{G}{G}) exactly, so the Elves never need to tap. Overrun gives +3/+3 and trample: Elves 4/4, Tusker 6/6, Bears 5/5, 15 trampling power. P3 is at 13 with a 2/1 Savannah Lions; whichever attacker the Lions block, only 1 damage is absorbed, so 14 reaches P3. Without the land drop Overrun needs the Elves' mana, the Elves are tapped, and 11 power minus 1 absorbed is 10: not lethal. Harmonize draws three cards but costs the same turn's mana. P4 is open at 40 and P2 has a 10/10 and a 4/5. The engine then asks how the blocked creature divides its damage: lethal (1) to the Lions and everything else to P3. Assigning it all to the blocker throws the kill away. Every step is forced by the goal: land, Overrun precombat, all three at P3, trample over.

lines.label: Forest, Overrun, all three attack P3
lines.why: Eliminates P3 this turn and keeps all three creatures.

lines.label: Right line, but all combat damage assigned to the blocker
lines.why: Everything correct until the damage split: with no trample damage assigned to the player P3 survives at 4.

lines.label: Overrun first (Elves tapped for mana), then attack P3 with what is left
lines.why: Same cards, wrong order: the Elves pay for Overrun and cannot attack, so P3 survives.

lines.label: Forest, Harmonize, attack P3 without Overrun
lines.why: Card advantage instead of the kill; 6 power into a blocker leaves P3 healthy.

lines.label: Forest, Overrun, all three attack P4
lines.why: 15 damage to a 40-life player; P3 was dead on board.
